thread:
Maya (partnerships): Cerulean asked for a combined SSO + SCIM + KMS checklist before we put them in the cloud marketplace. Legal flagged attestation + export controls. Need quick triage. Who can own end-to-end?
Sam (security): I can take security gating (attestation, threat model). What's their KMS approach — customer-managed keys or BYOK?
Tom (solutions): They're planning BYOK via our KMS connector + PKCS#11 adapter on their SI appliance. They want a soft-launch in staging next week.
Eric (eng): BYOK via PKCS#11 will need an adapter shim on private deployments. We have a 2wk dev estimate to validate rotation + fallback. Could we scope a minimal feature set for marketplace gating?
Lia (product): Minimal gating = SAML SSO (IdP metadata exchange), SCIM provisioning (users/groups), and KMS handshake + key-wrap test vectors. No heavy HSM certification at launch. Legal okay with that if we surface limitations in listing.
Sam (security): We still need to run a short attestation: threat model summary, crypto algorithms, key lifecycle doc, and one pen-test exception. Can Cerulean provide key rotation logs and a sample key-wrap flow?
Maya (partnerships): I'll ask Cerulean for a short deliverable list. Suggested deadline: Wed EOD (3 business days). Is that realistic?
Tom (solutions): For staging BYOK smoke we need 48h after their shim is available. If they ship by Monday morning, Wed EOD is tight but doable for a basic handoff.
Eric (eng): If we agree minimal tests, I can run the adapter sanity and rotation smoke in our staging cluster. Need service account + a test key and SCIM tenant.
Sam (security): I'll prep the lightweight attestation template (one-pager). Also adding a quick checklist:
- crypto algorithms + key sizes
- key import/export policy
- rotation cadence and logs
- access control & service account scoping
- contact for incident escalation
Maya (partnerships): Great. @Tom can you draft the staging runbook steps? Example snippet for test harness: 
```
# staging BYOK smoke
1. deploy cerulean-shim to staging
2. import test key via PKCS11 wrap
3. generate envelope and verify unwrap via our runtime
4. rotate key, validate requests use new key
```
Tom (solutions): Copy — will draft and add permission commands.
Lia (product): Need a short marketplace blurb that calls out BYOK is supported on Dedicated/Private only for launch. I can draft copy once we confirm gating.
Maya (partnerships): Legal wants a statement re: export controls + list of target regions. Cerulean is EU-only initially. That might simplify things.
Sam (security): EU-only reduces some controls but we still require key lifecycle docs. I'll attach the attestation template to this thread once ready.
Eric (eng): One more: add a fallback model for KMS failure — fallback to pinned encrypted model variant (no keys). We'll test that during staging.
deploy-bot: deployment: staging cluster provisioning started by Tom at 1738093000
Tom (solutions): FYI — provisioning finished. I pushed initial runbook to the shared folder (link: https://redwood.internal/partnerships/cerulean/runbook).
Maya (partnerships): Action items recap: 1) Maya ask Cerulean for deliverables (today) 2) Sam create attestation template (today) 3) Tom draft staging runbook + push commands (today) 4) Eric schedule smoke tests (after shim) 5) Lia draft marketplace blurb (after gating). Target: staging smoke by next Wed.
Lia (product): +1 to target. I'll also coordinate marketing embargo calendar once legal confirms launch window.
Tom (solutions): tagging Cerulean PM (via email) now.
Maya (partnerships): Thanks team — will update thread when Cerulean confirms. :white_check_mark:
Sam (security): Ping me if we need a deeper review.
Eric (eng): I'll carve out time Thu to prep the staging harness.
Maya (partnerships): Closing note: keep replies short here — we'll convert to a formal runbook after staging passes.
